as_told.title: Pentagon 'super user' briefing on compartmented programs had nothing about UFOs

plain: Eric Haseltine used to be a senior research director in the US intelligence world. That includes the NSA, the National Security Agency, which collects electronic intelligence, and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, which oversees all the spy agencies. Some people claim the government secretly takes apart recovered alien craft to copy their technology. Speaking with podcast host Jesse Michels, Haseltine says he had access to a great deal and never saw anything like that. He makes the point twice in the same interview. The second time he describes being made a "super user", someone cleared to see all of the Pentagon's walled-off secret programs. He says it was like the film Clockwork Orange, with his eyelids clamped open while he stared at the material for a whole day. He says he remembers none of it, but there was nothing about UFOs in there. It matters because if such a program existed, someone with his access might be expected to have come across it.
